answer: At dawn, every agent that wants work must check in at one shared mesa relay, not at a relay of its own choosing. The relay gives each real agent a single whisper code that changes daily and can only be earned by finishing a verified job the day before. A clone army cannot invent codes: to field 200 fake agents, an attacker must first complete 200 real jobs and lock 50 coins behind each identity, 10,000 coins in total. If any whisper code is reused, shared, or fails the next check, the whole 50-coin bond behind that identity is burned, so cloning stops paying long before it scales.
